title: The Glacier Suite Run
logline: A stressed concierge at an orbital ice retreat hires an outsider to pamper a difficult penthouse guest, unaware the guest is hiding from a syndicate repossession agent.

roles.description: Runs guest logistics at the orbital glacier lodge; perpetually stressed, drowning in hotel debt.
A flashy patron occupying the panoramic suite on exhausted credit, desperate to delay checkout.
A methodical repossession officer waiting patiently in the arrival lounge with a debt attachment warrant.
A sleek rented pleasure craft docked in the lodge's private berth with engines idling.
A luxury orbital lodge built into a hollowed comet spur, famous for zero-gravity ice baths.

public_situation: The luxury glacier lodge in {system} faces dockside tension as private security and repossession agents monitor arriving shuttles.
private_truth: {role:eccentric_guest} ran up enormous casino debts and holed up in {role:glacier_resort_dock}, stalling {role:resort_concierge} with worthless promissory notes while {role:syndicate_bailiff} closes in.

beats.public_change: The lodge concierge posts an expedited contract for rare comet ice to satisfy a VIP penthouse guest.

missions.reason: The concierge needs unpolluted comet core ice delivered immediately to appease the penthouse guest before his billing window expires.
missions.private_fact: The resort faces an immediate mortgage default if the high-roller checks out without settling his astronomical bar bill.

beats.public_change: The guest refuses to depart after receiving the ice, demanding an outside courier retrieve his private vault lockbox.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to retrieve a sealed diplomatic pouch from his impounded locker so he can settle his resort bill.
missions.private_fact: The pouch holds forged bearer drafts drawn on a defunct colonial trust rather than legitimate credits.

player_choice.prompt: {role:syndicate_bailiff} intercepts the pilot on the gangway, demanding the pouch to enforce the debt warrant, while {role:resort_concierge} begs to deposit it immediately.

options.label: Hand the pouch to the syndicate bailiff
Deliver the pouch to the resort concierge

beats.public_change: {role:eccentric_guest} bolts for his chartered skiff as the bailiff moves to seize his assets.

missions.reason: The bailiff contracts the pilot to disable the fleeing debtor's pleasure craft before it can jump beyond the system perimeter.
missions.private_fact: The fleeing guest offers a hoard of smuggled gemstones if the pilot breaks off the attack and lets him jump.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the pouch to the bailiff and disables the guest's chartered skiff.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_bailiff} arrests {role:eccentric_guest} and impounds his assets. {role:resort_concierge} is left with unpaid lodge bills.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a repo bailiff drag a deadbeat high-roller out of the glacier penthouse.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the guest's gemstone bribe during the dogfight and lets the skiff escape.
resolutions.summary: {role:eccentric_guest} jumps to safety with his fortune. {role:syndicate_bailiff} files a formal complaint against {role:glacier_resort_dock}.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the pouch directly to the concierge to clear the lodge's accounts.
resolutions.summary: {role:resort_concierge} books the forged drafts to stave off foreclosure, leaving {role:syndicate_bailiff} empty-handed when the audit hits.

consequences.public_summary: Word is a bankrupt resort stayed open by cashing deadbeat paper.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot refuses the guest's errand, or avoids involvement entirely.
resolutions.summary: The lodge cuts power to the penthouse suite. Creditors seize {role:glacier_resort_dock}, and {role:eccentric_guest} is taken into custody at the dock.

loose_threads.detail: The glacier lodge's mortgage note was assigned to a shell company sharing an office with the system tax tribunal.
The guest's bearer drafts bear the embossed wax seal of an investment bank that closed three decades ago.
All commercial extraction rights for the outer comet shelf were quietly bought out by a single blind syndicate broker.

radio_hooks: High-roller suite at {role:glacier_resort_dock} reportedly locked from the inside amid billing dispute.
Syndicate repossession agents spotted inspecting private berths in {system} outer belt.
Comet water ice prices fluctuate as luxury lodge demands emergency hospitality deliveries.

voice_direction.resort_concierge: Speaks in breathy, frantic customer service cadences. Constantly rephrases financial catastrophe as minor scheduling inconveniences.
voice_direction.eccentric_guest: Flamboyant, drawling, and condescending. Dismisses multi-million credit debts with airy hand-waving and changes the subject when asked for ID.
voice_direction.syndicate_bailiff: Slow, quiet, bureaucratic monotony. Recites statutory impound codes like grocery lists and never raises his pitch.
